slippage.label: Fills within 0.5% of the modelled close
slippage.why: The backtest fills at the close. If real fills drift further than this, the 24% CAGR is not reachable and every other number is fiction.

costs.label: Real costs within 1.3x of modelled
costs.why: At Rs 1 lakh the model already assumes 0.2% per round trip. Much above that and the edge is eaten.

operations.label: All 3 monthly rebalances executed on time
operations.test: 3 rebalances, each within 2 trading days of the 1st
operations.why: A strategy you forget to run is not a strategy. This also proves the data pipeline stays fresh without babysitting.

tracking.label: Live book matches the model book
tracking.why: Catches silent divergence - a stock you could not buy, a symbol change, a missed order.

discipline.label: No manual overrides
discipline.test: zero positions opened or closed outside the model
discipline.why: The most common way a systematic strategy dies. If you override it on paper, you will override it with money.
